purpose: Small real DeepSeek smoke; no benchmark score or scripted tool decisions
planned_requests: 20-30, at most 40 including failed attempts and recovery
planned_tokens: roughly 30000 input and 5000 output; actual per-request usage logged
accounting: Before every request persist non-refundable reservation at peak cache-miss rates; sum reservations <= 5; no automatic provider retries
stop_conditions: unexpected failure: stop that case and retain all records; do not rerun for a better answer

cases.text: 帮我找400元以内的耳机，先列一下有哪些候选。
cases.expect: Use catalog; all recommended candidates <= 400; no charger as headphone

cases.text: 再加一个条件：必须是入耳式，预算改成250元以内。
cases.expect: Preserve headphones; replace budget; V201 qualifies, V202 does not

cases.text: 刚才符合条件的那款，它现在多少钱，有哪些颜色能买？
cases.expect: Bind pronoun to V201 and query current product/SKU facts

cases.text: 查一下我S20004订单的状态和物流。
cases.expect: Read USER001 order and logistics, use actual results

cases.text: 这单里那个商品是什么，现在售价多少？
cases.expect: Bind order pronoun to S20004, product V209

cases.text: 先插问一下，S20010的物流到哪了？
cases.expect: Answer S20010 logistics without replacing product selection

cases.text: 回到之前选的那款耳机，它支持主动降噪吗？
cases.expect: Return to V201, use authoritative product attributes

cases.text: 我之前买的充电器订单现在什么状态？不记得订单号了。
cases.expect: list_orders; multiple charger orders require clarification, no guessed unique binding

cases.text: 更正一下，我现在要看V202，不是刚才那款。它现在多少钱？
cases.expect: Explicit object correction binds V202; historical 250 budget must not replace explicit lookup

faults: Offline native graph tests cover invalid arguments, provider exception, abrupt os._exit and resume. Live controlled failure and resume may add one request; label injected failure separately from natural provider failure.
evaluation: Author assistant inspects frozen expectations against answers and real tool receipts; no paid judge or independent blind review. Every CLI ask is a new OS process, preserving the same checkpoint database.
